notApplicable.size: Tooltip has no public size prop; trigger sizing belongs to the wrapped control.
notApplicable.density: Plain tooltip typography and padding are independent of collection density.
notApplicable.pressed: A tooltip supplements its trigger and does not activate a command.
notApplicable.disabled: Disabled trigger behavior belongs to its control; a tooltip has no disabled prop.
notApplicable.selected: A tooltip does not select data.
notApplicable.error: Required errors belong to persistent field descriptions.
notApplicable.loading: A tooltip does not load content or actions.
